P_0x003CF4: A Steel Dragon Squadron pilot. Educated, glib, and a womanizer with broad tastes. Once in the PTX special forces team, he's a first-rate pilot who can be ruthless for his goals. His father is Jonathan Kazahara of the Tesla Leicht Institute, co-developer of the Grungust. Rank: Lieutenant.
P_0x003F35: A Steel Dragon Squadron pilot. A shy, kind, pessimistic boy, bad at expressing his feelings and self-conscious about it. Loves tinkering with machines, which led him into developing a new Personal Trooper.
P_0x0040BE: A Steel Dragon Squadron pilot. Cheerful, serious, and just, with a strong hatred of losing; speaks her mind but can admit her own mistakes. Her father is Yuan, an executive at Mao Industries.
P_0x004257: Captain of the Hagane, 2nd Space Noah-class carrier. Matured in the DC War and L5 Campaign; took command after Daitetsu Minase died in the Inspector Incident. Now Lt. Cmdr.
P_0x0043B3: Bridge operator on the Hagane, 2nd Space Noah-class carrier, handling sensors. Skilled but glib and talkative. Formerly on the Shirogane before the DC War; recommended by Tetsuya to join the Hagane.
P_0x004561: Bridge operator on the Hagane, 2nd Space Noah-class carrier, handling comms. Moved from the 2nd to 1st bridge after the Shura Revolt. Quiet and reserved but a bit clumsy; loves cats and sings well.
